final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, 1.0 * number_of_orders / SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS share FROM customer_orders), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, gap_above_average FROM compared WHERE gap_above_average > 0 ORDER BY gap_above_average IS NULL, gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
